text.en:
PENAL CODE (CHAPTER 22)

DECLARATION OF COMMENCEMENT OF

PRESCRIBED PERIOD UNDER SECTION 277A

REVISED EDITION 2021

LAWS OF BRUNEI Penal Code CAP. 22,N 1 3 [Subsidiary]

SUBS1 DIARY LEGISLATION Declaration of commencement of prescribed period under section 277A The Minister of Development has declared that 4th August 2009 shall be the date of commencement of a prescribed period for the purpose of section 277A. B.L.R.O. 5~-30?1
